title: The satellite points
topic: Arlington Water Utilities in Tarrant County piloted satellite leak detection, where an algorithm turns a scan of the whole city into pins on a map, and a three-person crew with listening gear still has to find and fix each leak.
hook: This leak could hide for months.

treatment.logline: Three people, 1,470 miles of buried main and a leak nobody can see, until a satellite with a face tells them where to listen.
treatment.cold_open: A street cutaway in Arlington. A water main spits a jet into dark soil. On the curb above, a leak technician presses a listening rod to the asphalt, headphones on, and shakes her head because she hears nothing.
treatment.turn: A pin is not a leak. A crew still has to confirm and repair it, the second pilot puts people on the data, 7 of 10 of its test points had leaks, and both were still pilots under evaluation.
treatment.button: Back to the opening street. The satellite overhead drops one pin, the main below is clamped and dry, and the tablet's pin turns to a green check. The satellite points. The crew still digs.

hero.name: the leak satellite with a face
hero.why: a round gold satellite with blue solar wings, one big eye and acting brows, whose radar cone sweeps the city. It squints at Arlington, glances at Mars and beams pins down to a crew. No earlier film has drawn it.

throughline.object: the leak technician's tablet map of Arlington

scenes.vo: Under a street in Arlington, a water main is leaking. A leak technician listens, and hears nothing.

draw.subject: the buried water main
draw.action: cracks and sprays a jet into the soil under the street

draw.subject: the leak technician
draw.action: presses a listening rod to the asphalt with headphones on, then shakes her head

scenes.vo: A leak that stays underground can go unnoticed for weeks or even months.

draw.subject: the dark wet plume around the main
draw.action: spreads wider through the soil while calendar pages flip above the street
draw.emotion: a neighbour walks past on the sidewalk, unaware

scenes.vo: Arlington's water utility looks after 1,470 miles of water mains. Before satellites, it mostly relied on residents to report water flowing where it shouldn't be.

draw.subject: the tablet map
draw.action: draws itself on, blue main lines running out across the whole city

draw.subject: the leak technician
draw.action: walks in beside the finished map and points at its streets

draw.subject: a resident
draw.action: points at water running down the curb and raises a phone to call it in

scenes.vo: Then a team of three went out to listen. They place acoustic gear on valves and over the lines, and triangulate a suspected leak. That is three people for 1,470 miles of main.

draw.subject: the crew truck
draw.action: rolls in with its amber bar flashing as three technicians step out
draw.emotion: they look up and down the street, determined

draw.subject: the three technicians
draw.action: stride out to three valve lids in the street, rods in hand

draw.subject: three sound rings
draw.action: spread from three valves and cross right over the hidden leak

draw.subject: a green check
draw.action: lands where the three rings cross, and the three technicians cheer

scenes.vo: So the city tried looking down from orbit. In a pilot, a company called ASTERRA scans the entire city with satellites, for moisture and temperature underground.

draw.subject: the satellite
draw.action: swings into frame over the curve of the earth and its big eye opens

draw.subject: the satellite
draw.action: narrows its eye and locks onto Arlington with a click

draw.subject: the radar cone
draw.action: sweeps down the technician's own street, block by block, as she looks up from the curb

scenes.vo: The company says its radar looks for the unique signature of drinking water. The city says the technology once looked for water on Mars.

draw.subject: the radar waves
draw.action: pass down through the asphalt and soil and light up the wet plume around the pipe in cyan

draw.subject: the wet soil around the pipe
draw.action: lights up in a cyan ring under the radar

draw.subject: the satellite
draw.action: glances at a small red Mars, then flicks its eye back down to Arlington

scenes.vo: Then an algorithm turns that scan into points of interest. Each one is a pin on the crew's map, a place to go check.

draw.subject: the algorithm machine
draw.action: swallows the scan strip, its gears turn, and a gold pin pops out of its chute

visual_events.at_phrase: a pin on the crew's map
visual_events.label: Point of interest

draw.subject: the gold pin
draw.action: drops onto the technician's tablet map and bounces

scenes.vo: By last November, ASTERRA had handed the city about 340 of those pins. They led to 34 leaks detected and repaired. A pin is not a leak. A crew still drives out to confirm it and repair it.

draw.subject: gold pins
draw.action: rain onto the tablet in the technician's hands while a counter climbs to 340

draw.subject: the pin counter
draw.action: slams down on 340 as the last pins land

draw.subject: 34 of the pins
draw.action: flip to green checks one after another, the rest staying gold

visual_events.at_phrase: A pin is not a leak
visual_events.label: A pin is not a leak

draw.subject: the crew truck
draw.action: pulls up beside one gold pin standing in the street, amber bar flashing

draw.subject: a crew member
draw.action: swings a shovel into the asphalt right at the pin

scenes.vo: In July, the utility also tested a second program, Paradigm. Its people check the satellite data against a map of valves and hydrants. One pilot runs on an algorithm. The other runs on people.

draw.subject: two analysts
draw.action: pin a map of valves and hydrants on the wall and step back to look

draw.subject: the satellite sheet
draw.action: slides over the valve and hydrant map and its dots settle on the symbols

draw.subject: one analyst
draw.action: circles a hydrant symbol with a red pencil where a satellite dot sits on it

visual_events.at_phrase: One pilot runs on an algorithm
visual_events.label: Algorithm or people

draw.subject: a hard split
draw.action: slams down, the algorithm machine whirring on one side and the two analysts pointing on the other

scenes.vo: When the city tested Paradigm, 7 out of 10 points had leaks. It has helped locate 33 city leaks.

draw.subject: ten pins in a row
draw.action: fill one by one, seven with blue water and three staying empty

draw.subject: the tally board
draw.action: stamps 33 and the analyst gives a thumbs up

scenes.vo: The city estimates ASTERRA saved 1,130,567 gallons of water, and $440,800 in lost water costs. Its conservation supervisor says satellite programs prevent the team from spending entire days searching for leaks.

draw.subject: a repair clamp
draw.action: bolts over the crack in the open trench and the spray stops
draw.emotion: the crew member in the trench grins

draw.subject: a water jug
draw.action: swells until it towers over the Arlington rooftops as the gallon counter climbs
draw.emotion: the technician gapes up at it

draw.subject: the full jug
draw.action: sloshes to the brim as the counter lands, bubbles racing up

draw.subject: a price tag
draw.action: swings onto the jug's neck and settles

draw.subject: the conservation supervisor
draw.action: turns to a wall calendar full of crossed-out search days and frowns at it

draw.subject: the conservation supervisor
draw.action: wipes a week of crossed-out search days off a wall calendar

scenes.vo: The utility's year-end report adds a finder that doesn't orbit. Splash, a leak detection dog, sniffs for small amounts of chlorine.

draw.subject: Splash the dog
draw.action: trots along the curb nose down, tail wagging

draw.subject: Splash
draw.action: drops his nose to the asphalt beside a valve lid, tail wagging hard

draw.subject: Splash
draw.action: stops on the spot and sits beside the technician, nose to the asphalt
draw.emotion: the technician kneels and pats him, proud

scenes.vo: As of last November, both pilots were under evaluation for permanent use. The satellite points. The crew still digs.

draw.subject: the tablet map
draw.action: turns the pin under the technician into a green check as a PILOT tag swings beside it

draw.subject: the satellite overhead
draw.action: beams one pin down to the street while the crew member pats the patched asphalt over a dry, clamped main
draw.emotion: the technician grins up at it
